programme.title: The Curse Of Oak Island
programme.desc: Tiimin kisatessa lähestyvää talvea vastaan saadakseen Oak Islandin aarteen Rick ja seuran jäsenet solmivat uusia yhteyksiä 6 000 kilometrin päässä Maltalla.

programme.title: The UnXplained With William Shatner
programme.desc: Satojen vuosien ajan on kerrottu tarinoita monista suurista aarteista, jotka on piilotettu kautta Yhdysvaltojen. Ovatko tarinat kadonneista aarteista silkkaa satua? Onko mahdollista, että arvotavarat ovat jossain tuolla odottamassa löytäjäänsä?

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Rick yrittää tehdä kaupat, kun liikkeeseen ilmestyy signeerattu Jaws-juliste. Tarttuuko myyjä syöttiin vai joutuuko Rick sanomaan: Tarvitsemme isomman tarjouksen?. Chum tähtää varsijousella. Tähtääkö hän tarjoukseen vai meneekö kaupat ohi?

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Kun myyjä tuo FI-pienoisautokokoelman, Rickin on päätettävä antaako kaasua vai painaako jarrua. Sitten Chum tarttuu KAWS-takkiin, onko se tyylikäs siirto liikkeelle vai muodikas virhe?

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Palkittu toimittaja Linda Moulton Howe on yli 40 vuoden ajan raportoinut maapallon mystisimmistä ilmiöistä. Voisivatko hänen tutkimuksensa eläinkuolemista satomuodostelmiin ja muukalaisten tekemiin kaappauksiin johtaa meidät uuteen todellisuuteen?

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Voisivatko löydöt Andien kätkemästä kadonneesta kaupungista, salaperäisistä metallipalloista, jotka eivät ole tästä maailmasta, ja upotetusta kaupungista, jonka sanottiin olevan jumalten koti, olla todisteena maan ulkopuolisesta yhteydestä?

programme.title: The Curse of Oak Island
programme.desc: Tutkittuaan Portugalin Azoreiden saarilla sijaitsevia muinaisia rakennelmia, jotka muistuttavat Oak Islandilta löydettyjä rakenteita, tutkimusryhmä aloittaa mittavat kaivaukset Money Pit - alueella, josta on löydetty merkkejä haudatusta aarteesta.

programme.desc: Sarjassa tutkitaan kymmentä salaperäistä vuorta, jotka tunnetaan yliluonnollisista ilmiöistä. Sri Lankan vuorenhuipulta, jonka sanotaan olevan portaali muihin maailmoihin, Washingtonin tulivuoreen, jolla tehtiin kuuluisa ufohavainto.

programme.title: CHI de Genève - Best Moments
programme.desc: The 59th edition of the CHI de Genève is about to take place at the Palexpo Geneva. The top riders are ready for one of Europe's most demanding courses. They have at stake the Rolex Grand Slam of Show Jumping and a spot at the hall of fame. Relive the best moments of the 2019 edition of the CHI de Genève.

programme.title: Horse Academy Pro - Chapter 2
programme.desc: Get ready for a ride with us in this new episode of Horse Academy Pro! This time, Rolf Göran-Bengtsson will be teaching us how to make proper turns and students will be practicing jumps in a closed circuit with their horses. They will be increasing the height as students get better, will they be capable to adapt quickly to Bengtsson's teachings? Find it out on this exclusive show on HorseTV.

programme.title: Jumping International Le Saut Hermès - Highlights Prix du 24 Faubourg
programme.desc: After the famous Le Saut Hermès, the Prix du 24 Faubourg is also a competition with a classification of CSI5* but this time with point accumulation and against the clock. With obstacles from 1.50m to 1.60m, it is a big challenge with a progressive difficulty as rider and horse advance on the course. Relive the best moments of the Prix du 24 Faubourg in its 2019 edition.

programme.title: Polo Rider Cup Highlights - Highlights
programme.desc: Polo Rider Cup Highlights - Highlights

programme.title: The Polo Show - Episode 5
programme.desc: Today we will share with you some of the highlights of some of the best Women's Tournaments of 2019. We went to Florida to enjoy the US Open Women's Championship, across the Atlantic to England for the Staple International between England and Argentina, over to France where we stopped in Saint-Tropez for the Women's International and in Chantilly for the Women's French Open. Then back over to Argentina to enjoy the Pink Polo at Thai Polo Club.

programme.title: CHIO Aachen - Best Moments
programme.desc: Words speak for themselves. An equestrian show unrivalled anywhere in the world, offering the highest level of performance. The CHIO Aachen is probably the most prestigious horse show in Europe when it comes to show jumping and dressage. Riders compete against each other in this episode for victory in the show jumping competition. Relive all the magic moments of the 2019 edition of the CHIO Aachen.

programme.title: Longines Global Champions Tour - Episode 5 - Saint Tropez
programme.desc: We move on to sunny Saint Tropez to celebrate the fifth leg of the Longines Global Champions Tour 2022. Young talent Gilles Thomas has moved his way to second place in the standings, but Pieter Devos counts with years of experience and will not give up his first position so easily. Who will win Saint Tropez's GP?

programme.title: Global Champions League - Episode 5 - Saint Tropez
programme.desc: Highlights from the Global Champions League leg in Rome.

programme.title: The Dutch Masters 2021 Highlights
programme.desc: As the largest indoor show in the Netherlands, The Dutch Masters (Indoor Brabant Horse Show) has already stood for top-class equestrian sport for half a century. Together with the CHI Genève, CSIO Spruce Meadows Masters and the CHIO Aachen, the Dutch Masters is one of the four top events of the respected Rolex Grand Slam. The best riders in the world meet up every year in March in a bid to ride to victory in the legendary Brabanthallen. The first World Cup Final of showjumping was staged in this venue for the first time in 1994, and since prestigious competitions and more finals have taken place in one of the four pillars of showjumping and dressage. Intense competitions meet exquisite entertainment amid the unique atmosphere of the Dutch Masters. You can now watch the highlights of the competition on Horse TV.

programme.title: Dubai Polo Gold Cup - Final
programme.desc: The world's best polo teams meet at the Dubai Polo Gold Cup competition. After days of competition, UAE and AM are the two lasting teams who will dispute the most important Polo tournament in Asia and the Middle East. They will have to show a combination of equestrian pursuits, skills and team effort to win. Relive the 2020 final between UAE vs. AM.

programme.title: Sunshine Tour - Week 5
programme.desc: The fifth week of the Sunshine Tour 2020 is running short due to the COVID-19 pandemic, but the exciting past weeks of the competition are not over until the Suzuki Grand Prix is disputed. In the last day of the XXVI Sunshine Tour, both riders and horses enjoyed a wonderful competition, and the best riders have made it to the jumpoff. Enjoy the best moments of the fifth week of the Sunshine Tour, on HorseTV.

programme.desc: In this month's show, we look back on Boyd Exell's memorable 2018 driving season and travel to Reykjavik to learn more about the Icelandic Horse breed. programme.desc: This time, we are in Bordeaux to find out who will be crowned the FEI Driving World Cup Champion and we return to Iceland to learn more about their equine enterprises. We will also visit one of the leading coachbuilders in the world to see how horseboxes are made and travel to Abu Dhabi for the series opener of the Longines FEI Jumping Nations Cup.

programme.title: Sunshine Tour - Episode 1 - CSI4 * Andalucía Grand Prix
programme.desc: With a CSI4* rating, the Sunshine Tour is one of Europe’s toughest competitions. Here, a single mistake could mean the end of the competition.Don’t miss the incredible actions of week one of the Spanish Sunshine Tour.

programme.title: The Who - Live At The Isle Of Wight Festival 2004
programme.desc: In 2004 The Who returned to the Isle Of Wight Festival for the first time since their legendary performance in 1970. After a long absence, the festival had been reborn in 2002 and continues to this day. Their UK concerts in 2004 were the first in their home country since the death of founder member John Entwistle.

programme.title: Leon Bridges - Live in London 2015
programme.desc: The Apple Music Festival (formerly known as the iTunes Festival) was a music concert series held by Apple, Inc. inaugurated in 2007.

programme.title: Pharrell Williams - Live in London
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Pharrell Williams performs his hits including Marilyn Monroe, Come Get It Bae, Happy and many more.

programme.title: 2CELLOS - Live in London 2011
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Jerry Lee Lewis - Jerry Lee Lewis and Friends
programme.desc: Jerry Lee Lewis is one of the founding fathers of Rock n Roll. He was one of the original Sun Records quartet along with Elvis Presley, Carl Perkins and Johnny Cash who between them defined the music of a generation. His recording career has stretched from the mid-50s to the present day and his unique style of piano playing has influenced scores of musicians over the years.

programme.title: Bring Me the Horizon - Reading And Leeds Festival 2022
programme.desc: The Reading and Leeds Festivals are a pair of music festivals that take place annually in the cities of Reading and Leeds in England. Featuring Bring Me The Horizon.

programme.title: The Cure - Eurockéennes 2012
programme.desc: The legendary rock band The Cure hits the stage at Eurockéennes in Belfort, in 2012.

programme.title: Metallica - Orion Festival: Tour Through the Never
programme.desc: Filmed at Atlantic City's Orion Festival, this ripper concert film gives fans the full Metallica live experience, packing hits like One, Master of Puppets, Sad But True and Seek and Destroy.

programme.title: Charlie Puth - Live in London 2015
programme.desc: Charlie Puth performs during the 2015 Apple Music Festival at The Roundhouse on September 20, 2015 in London, England.

programme.title: Guns N' Roses - Live From The O2 Arena London
programme.desc: Watch this mega-production of Guns N’ Roses performing live at the O2 Arena to its fans singing and vibrating to each song. Includes; Paradise City, Sweet Child O’ Mine, November Rain and many more.

programme.title: Green Day - Live at Fox Theater
programme.desc: Live concert of legendary punk-rock band Green Day on April 14, 2009, performing the whole of their imminent new album, 21st Century Breakdown, at the Fox Theater in the band's hometown, Oakland, California.

programme.title: Robert Plant - Live in London 2014
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: John Lee Hooker - Live At Montreux 1990
programme.desc: The legendary bluesman John Lee Hooker brought his boogie style blend of rhythm And blues to deliver two blistering performances at the Montreux Jazz Festival in 1983 and 1990. Returning to the prestigious festival in 1990 with The Coast To Coast Blues Band the tracklist features hits such as ‘Boom Boom”, “The Healer” and his no.1 Jukebox hit “Boogie Chillen’”.

programme.title: Slash And Myles Kennedy And The Conspirators - Live At The Roxy
programme.desc: The atmospheric venue, steeped in rock history, gave fans a brilliant opportunity to experience the band up close as they delivered a set packed with more recent solo tracks, including several from the new album, and classics from Slash’s earlier career with Guns ‘n’ Roses and Velvet Revolver. The intimate setting inspired the band to deliver a scintillating, dynamic performance that is brilliantly captured on this digital release.

programme.title: Johnny Cash - Music In Review
programme.desc: The film features rare archive interviews with Johnny and the reflections of a team of leading critics and working musicians, including ‘Cowboy’ Jack Clement and Bob Wooton and ‘Fluke’ Holland from The Tennessee Three. This penetrating critical analysis draws on rare archive footage of Johnny Cash in performance, from radio and television archives around the world tracing the career of the man dubbed ‘the man in black’.

programme.title: James Morrison - T In The Park
programme.desc: T in the Park festival is a major Scottish music festival that has been held almost annually since 1994 (the event did not take place in 2017). It is named after its main sponsor, the brewing company Tennents.

programme.title: Radiohead - The King of Limbs: Live from the Basement
programme.desc: The King of Limbs: Live from the Basement is a 2011 live video album by the English alternative rock band Radiohead, performing their eighth album, The King of Limbs (2011).

programme.title: AC/DC - Circus Krone
programme.desc: Filmed at the world famous Circus Krone in Munich, this AC/DC concert from June 17, 2003 features standout performances of Rock N Roll Damnation and What's Next To The Moon and more.

programme.title: Lynyrd Skynyrd - Live From The Florida Theater
programme.desc: Earlier this year Lynyrd Skynyrd performed their first two studio albums, “Pronounced ‘Lĕh-’nérd ‘Skin-’nérd” and “Second Helping”, live in their entirety for the first time, at two specially staged concerts at the Florida Theatre in their home town of Jacksonville, Florida. It was a special occasion for both the act and their fans as the band performed tracks they’d never or rarely played live before alongside classic songs that are an essential part of any Lynyrd Skynyrd live show.

programme.title: Coldplay - SXSW - Live in Austin
programme.desc: Filmed at The Moody Theater in Austin, Texas, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Coldplay featuring unforgettable version of their hits: Viva La Vida, Fix You, Clocks and many more…

programme.title: Take That - Wonderland Live From The O2
programme.desc: Celebrating the release of their eighth studio album Wonderland, Take That invite you to experience their sensational 2017 concert.

programme.title: Panic! At the Disco - Rock Am Ring 2016
programme.desc: Rock im Park is a music festival that takes place in Nuremberg, Germany, lasting three days. Featuring : Panic! At the Disco

programme.title: Justin Bieber - Live at Madison Square Garden
programme.desc: The film follows the pop star Justin Bieber during 10 days counting down to his performance at Madison Square Garden. It also includes footage from his My World Tour, interviews with family and friends, a visit to his original hometown in Canada, and some of the story and videos of his childhood.

programme.title: Rod Stewart - Live at Hyde Park
programme.desc: A concert by the legendary Rod Stewart, that closed Radio 2's Annual Festival In A Day, held in September 2015 in London's Hyde Park.

programme.title: Duran Duran - The Reunion Tour: Live at Wembley
programme.desc: Filmed at Wembley Arena, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Duran Duran featuring unforgettable version of their hits: Rio, Hungry Like The Wolf, The Reflex and many more…

programme.title: The Offspring - Rock AM
programme.desc: The Offspring is an American rock band from Garden Grove, California, formed in 1984. Originally formed under the name Manic Subsidal, the band's lineup consists of lead vocalist and rhythm guitarist Bryan Dexter Holland, bassist Todd Morse and lead guitarist Kevin Noodles Wasserman.

programme.title: Ellie Goulding - Live at the iTunes Festival
programme.desc: Do not just be fascinated by the beauty and girlishness of this bright-eyed Englishwoman. Ellie Goulding has a lot more to offer fans of good pop music and its electronic variations. Since releasing her first album in 2010, Ellie has traveled the world to showcase her talents, both in the voice and in the composition of her songs. These talents can be seen in this show at the iTunes Festival in London, with special mention for the songs Burn, Halcyon, Lights and My Blood.

programme.title: Alabama Shakes - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: Mixing classic RAndB vocals with a soulful blues-rock base, Alabama Shakes have taken garage rock and turned it on its head. Alabama Shakes takes the Austin City Limits stage for the second time in support of their newest album Sound And Color.

programme.title: The Strokes - Live at Landmark Music Festival
programme.desc: And as with other hugely successful rock bands, it was the lead singer who was in charge of pumping up the crowd, with Julian Casablancas yelling things like “D.C., let’s rock!” and “What’s up, D.C.?!” The crowd went wild, but to Casablancas, it was clearly a joke. He was playing a role and said as much outright at the beginning of the show, but that didn’t stop the crowd, hungry for more entertainment, from taking him seriously.

programme.title: Ozzy Osbourne - God Bless Ozzy Osbourne
programme.desc: Ozzy Osbourne is one of the most iconic figures in rock and one of the founding fathers of heavy metal. God Bless Ozzy Osbourne tells for the first time the story of his career from the founding of Black Sabbath through to solo stardom and his wider fame beyond.

programme.title: Kasabian - Live at iTunes Festival
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007

programme.title: John Mayall - 70th Birthday Concert
programme.desc: Liverpools Kings Dock on July 19 2003 was the venue for a long awaited and much anticipated reunion between Eric Clapton and John Mayall And the Bluesbreakers. The occasion was both a celebration of John Mayalls 70th year and a fundraiser for Unicef. Also invited to the party were former Bluesbreaker and Rolling Stone Mick Taylor and veteran trombonist Chris Barber. If youre a lover of the blues it doesnt get much better than this. The show ran for around two and a half hours and the film is now presented here in its entirety for the first time.

programme.title: Coldplay - SXSW - Live in Austin
programme.desc: Filmed at The Moody Theater in Austin, Texas, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Coldplay featuring unforgettable version of their hits: Viva La Vida, Fix You, Clocks and many more…

programme.title: Eric Clapton And Steve Winwood - Eric Clapton And Steve Winwood - Live from MSG
programme.desc: History rocked and rock made history during a sold-out three-gig stand at Madison Square Garden in late February 2008 when icons Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood performed a concert together for the first time since their all-too-brief days in the legendary Blind Faith in 1969. Whether they will ever team again is unknown. But with Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood Live From Madison Square Garden fans everywhere are able to experience the sound and the glory of a performance on that famous stage by two of rock's greatest artists.

programme.title: Florence And The Machine - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Stevie Ray Vaughan - Lonestar
programme.desc: This film traces and reveals The Full, Previously Un-Told Story Of Stevie Ray Vaughan's Glory Years, the period between the release of his debut album and his tragic death in a helicopter crash in 1989.

programme.title: Jeff Beck - Rock and Roll Party Honoring Les Paul
programme.desc: Join Jeff Beck and his special guests as they play tribute to the legendary Les Paul in New York City, filmed on what was to be his 95th birthday. Sit back, relax and turn it up. You are about to experience magic!

programme.title: AC/DC - Circus Krone
programme.desc: Filmed at the world famous Circus Krone in Munich, this AC/DC concert from June 17, 2003 features standout performances of Rock N Roll Damnation and What's Next To The Moon and more.

programme.title: Paul Simon - Live in New York City
programme.desc: During the first leg of Paul Simon's triumphant, 2011 U.S. tour, he thrilled hometown fans with a special club performance at New York City's historic Webster Hall. The show presents this iconic artist working at the peak of his artistic and creative powers in an unusually intimate setting. The 20-song, 90-minute set list was drawn from his legendary career and includes several songs that haven't been performed live in many years. Kodachrome, Mother and Child Reunion, Gone At Last and The Obvious Child are just some of the highlights as well as songs from Simon's most recent album, 2011's So Beautiful or So What (Hear Music/Concord Music Group) including Dazzling Blue, Rewrite, The Afterlife and the album's propulsive title track.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes
programme.desc: A woman of faith, Susan Hernandez seems like the last person police would expect to find murdered in her basement. While searching for suspects, detectives leave no stone unturned in the hunt for Susan’s killer -- the outcome shakes the town to its core.

programme.title: Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: Michael Crump may have been a small-time drug dealer, but he wasn't violent; that is, until he was convicted of murdering another local dealer in an apparent robbery gone bad. Now his family has reached out to Chris Anderson and Fatima Silva for help.

programme.title: Suomen huutokauppakeisari
programme.desc: Sampo Kaulanen haastaa Akin maalaamaan ihonsa. Markku tekee lumihangesta hämmentävän löydön. Heli uskoo tynnyreiden vetovoimaan.

programme.title: Savotta (S)
programme.desc: Riitta vierailee FinnMetko konemessuilla. Antti Ruuskanen suunnittelee uuden metsäkoneen hankintaa, mutta saadaanko kauppaa vahvistettua? Metsurit kaavat puita omakotitaloalueella, ja Annastiina käy tarkistamassa, millaisia tuhoja kirjanpainaja on tehnyt metsäpalstalla.

programme.desc: I denna serie tar bästsäljande författaren och förkunnaren Max Lucado med oss till Bibelns berättelse om Josef. Utifrån hans liv kan vi lära oss att det finns en väg framåt, även i de mörkaste och mest hopplösa perioderna av livet.

programme.title: BibelPodden - Varför är GT så upptaget med rent och orent?
programme.desc: I Bibelpodden dyker Jonas Bergsten, Jonas Dagson, Malin Davidsson och Per Ewert med gäster ner i intressanta spår i världens mest inflytelserika bok. Bibelpodden är ett samarbete mellan Claphaminstitutet och Kristen Media Sverige.I veckans avsnitt återser vi Dan Sarkar, som guidar oss genom Gamla testamentets renhetsregler. Hur ska vi förstå dessa i vår kultur så annorlunda lagar? Och hur blir Jesus den som både uppfyller alla regler, och den som på djupet kan rena människan från all orenhet? Ytterligare fördjupning finns i Dans bok Galna Testamentet? Vi kopplar även upp Jonas Bergsten på länk från Florida och hör om de olika samarbeten som Kärnbibeln gör på engelska och spanska, men också om ett växande intresse för Bibeln i Syd- och Nordamerika. Och som bonus slänger vi också in en omgång quiz, på temat Gamla testamentet, Nya testamentet eller Joakim Berg [sångare och textförfattare i bandet Kent]?Start huvudintervju: 8.45.

programme.title: Ett enklare liv
programme.desc: På den skotska västkusten hittar Ben familjen Goddard som några år tidigare valde att lämna sitt bekväma stadsliv för en självförsörjande livsstil. Vädret på ön Rùm kan vara nyckfullt men för familjen är det en dröm som blivit sann.

programme.title: Världens natur
programme.desc: Sötvatten är både livets förutsättning och många djurs livsmiljö. När skyfallen dränker Costa Ricas regnskogar samlas trädgrodorna för att leka uppe på grenarna. Där läggs äggen på ett blad och när de kläcks ramlar ynglen ner i en perfekt barnkammare.

programme.title: Så gjordes Planet Earth III
programme.desc: Följ med bakom kulisserna och ta del av vilket arbete som krävs för att skapa en av världens mest spektakulära naturserier.

programme.title: Människans bästa vän
programme.desc: I Louisiana, USA, har Denny blivit vän med en sumpbäver. Efter att ha sett bäverns familj dödas av en bil, kunde Denny inte lämna den lilla ungen utan tog hand om honom. Han kämpade till och med i domstol för att få ett unikt tillstånd att behålla honom. På andra sidan Atlanten på den engelska landsbygden tar Martin hand om en blind igelkott vid namn Terry, efter att ha lämnat sitt liv som bankman för att rehabilitera skadade igelkottar. I Sydafrika förbereder Belinda en grön markatta vid namn Cosima för ett liv i det vilda, medan Claire i sitt hem tar hand om en serval - en vildkatt som blivit hennes ständiga följeslagare.

programme.title: Världens historia
programme.desc: När kung Sven dör rasar kampen om England. Knut misslyckas, tvingas fly och låter sin vrede gå ut över den engelska gisslan, men i exilen föds planen på en skoningslös återkomst. Med stöd av mäktiga krigsherrar inleder han ett nytt fälttåg som ska avgöra om vikingarna kan ta makten över ett av Europas rikaste riken.

programme.title: Antikens riken
programme.desc: I en oförutsägbar värld måste våra forntida makter lägga grunden till sina samhällen för att visa sin styrka och skydda sitt folk. Vilka kommer att bygga upp sitt land till ärans höjder?

programme.title: Vilda västern
programme.desc: Kapitlet om vilda västern avslutas när USA:s land sträcker sig över hela kontinenten, men nationen bär på ärren efter en systematisk etnisk rensning av ursprungsbefolkningar.

programme.title: Världens natur: Sri Lanka
programme.desc: I alla tider har Sri Lanka dragit till sig sjöfarare av olika slag. Europeiska och arabiska fartyg kom hit i jakten på kryddor. Havssköldpaddorna söker upp stränderna för att lägga sina ägg där de en gång själv kläcktes.

programme.title: Världens natur: Badlands
programme.desc: I hjärtat av mellanvästra USA finns ett kargt landskap där svartsvansade präriehundar, prärieugglor och bisonoxar kämpar för att överleva.

programme.title: Så byggdes Sverige
programme.desc: Följ med Petra Mede, Gert Wingårdh och Mark Isitt på en underhållande tidsresa om hur våra svenska hus, hem och städer vuxit fram, med start för 100 år sedan och med sikte 100 år in i framtiden. Första resan går till Villagatan, där Petra njuter av egnahemsidyllen i Enskede. Mark råkar på drottning Elizabeth bland Norra Ängbys småstugor och Gert besöker H55-utställningen i Helsingborg. Vi kliver även in i 70-talets kataloghus och träffar husdrömmarparet Marie och Bill. Och hur kan den svenska husdrömmen se ut i framtiden?

programme.title: Resfeber: Turismens pris
programme.desc: Turism står för ungefär åtta procent av världens koldioxidutsläpp. Men hur vänder vi trenden för resandets miljökostnader? Balis berömda risterrasser är hotade, och i Kenya är gemensamma safarireservat framtiden för de maasaibönder som också vill behålla sin tradition.

programme.title: På resa med Bachstad: Japan
programme.desc: Øystein och Rune börjar sin resa i Tokyo och gör det mesta av besöket. De träffar en norsk komiker som är big in Japan, besöker ett ugglecafé och en fiskmarknad och gör stora inköp.

programme.title: Elefantens själ
programme.desc: Naturfilm från 2017. En efter en faller de gamla elefanterna i Östafrika offer för tjuvjägare. De berömda naturfilmarna Dereck och Beverley Joubert har under många år med förtvivlan följt deras minskning. Men vad upplever elefanterna själva i den intensiva förföljelsens tid? Den frågan leder dem rätt in i elefantens själ.

programme.title: Fråga Lund
programme.desc: Programledaren Robin testar att springa ifrån en spårhund. Rymdfysikern Gabriella tar hjälp av Henrik för att demonstrera hur internet vet att du inte är en robot och så reder språkvetaren Jenny ut om djur har språk. Medverkande: Robin Paulsson, Gabriella Stenberg Wieser, Elsa Trolle Önnerfors, Jessica Abbott, Jenny Nilsson och Henrik Widegren.

programme.title: Destination Asien
programme.desc: I kölden på Himalayas sluttningar har de fått platta nosar och tyr sig till varandra för att hålla värmen. På Thailands stränder har de lärt sig att öppna skaldjur med stenar. Aporna i Asien är lika varierade som djurlivet i övrigt på den väldiga kontinenten.

programme.title: Övergivna byggnader
programme.desc: I Polen ligger ett sagolikt slott på en klippavsats. Under det döljer sig ett omfattande tunnelsystem, förknippat med den seglivade legenden om försvunnet nazistguld. I den amerikanska staden Atlanta står ett palatsliknande hem, uppfört med förmögenheten från ett världsberömt affärsimperium. Och i Libanon, det kända hotel Grand Sofar, som till slut fastnade i korselden när landet slets sönder av inbördeskrig. Del 7 av 8.

programme.title: Alone Australien
programme.desc: Att inte veta hur många konkurrenter som återstår i tävlingen påverkar deltagarna psykiskt - är slutet en dag bort, eller 6 månader?

programme.title: Huutokauppataisto
programme.desc: Valtava Gatling-ase ja Nabisco Cookiesin harvinainen mainos kiinnostavat ostajia Las Vegasin uhkapelihuutokaupassa.

programme.title: Latela 2024
programme.desc: Tuhansien kilometrien jälkeen drifting-auton aihio on saatu perille ja Team Latela kerääntyy ihmettelemään ostosta.

programme.title: Barnwood Builders
programme.desc: Mark Bowe ja hänen ammattitaitoinen käsityöläisporukkansa hyödyntävät uusiokäytössä vanhoja latoja ja mökkejä. He käyttävät puuta ja muita materiaaleja upeiden, nykyaikaisten kotien luomiseen.

programme.title: Vasily Petrenko, Nikolai Lugansky, Verbier Festival Orchestra: Tchaikovsky
programme.desc: Piotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky 1840-1893 Piano Concerto No. 1 in B-flat minor Op. 23 The Nutcracker, Act II. Festival de Verbier, 22 July 2024.

programme.title: Estonian Festival Orchestra, Paavo Järvi: Hallik, Pärt, Stravinsky - Pärnu Music Festival
programme.desc: Elis Hallik 1986 – . Arvo Pärt 1935) – Tabula rasa Silhouette. Igor Stravinsky 1882 – 1971 The Firebird, Suite (1919). Pärnu, Concert Hall, 20 July 2025.

programme.title: Accident: A family portrait
programme.desc: Accident: A family portrait. Eugène-Auguste Ysaÿe: 6 Sonatas for solo violin. In ‘Accident’, death comes unexpectedly and abruptly to a family that has recently been challenged by the pater familia's marriage to a younger woman. When he dies suddenly, perhaps in a car accident, it becomes extremely important for her to push forward a delayed plan for a family portrait. How to take a family photo where one of the members is no longer alive, and the rest of the family, apart from the young wife, struggle to hide their opposition to the whole project? It is a grotesque task for the photographer, who routinely does everything possible to create a good atmosphere in the studio for his clients.. Directed by Jo Strømgren and Stein-Roger Bull 2021.

programme.title: Stravinsky: Les Noces, The Rite of Spring - Ljubljana Festival
programme.desc: Les Noces The Rite of Spring. Music: Igor Stravinsky. Choreographer: Edward Clug Conductor: Simon Krečič, . SNG Maribor Ballet Ensemble. Assistant Choreographer: Gaj Žmavc Set designer: Marko Japelj Costume designer: Leo Kulaš Lighting designer: Tomaž Premzl. Les Noces Andreja Zakonjšek Krt, soprano Dada Kladenik, alt Tim Ribič, tenor Janko Volčanšek, bass. With everything on the line, these stars face intense pressure, life-changing decisions and the harsh realities of climbing the racing ladder. An inspiring and revealing look at what it really takes to make it to the top.

programme.title: Special
programme.desc: The TT from Audi has been extremely successful as a sports car since 1998. In 2014, the third generation of the Audi bestseller is presented to the world. Four years of development time are needed before the new generation TT is ready for series production. The documentation 'A Car is Born' provides an exciting insight into the entire development of the TT.

programme.title: MotorStories
programme.desc: The SEMA Show in Las Vegas is the biggest and best-known tuning exhibition in the world. From complexly rebuilt show cars to giant off-road monster trucks: anything is represented here. But these cars don't just stand around. Virtually anyone from the scene presents themselves during the legendary cruise. And at the after-show party 'SEMA Ignited', they make the asphalt melt.

programme.title: Made in...
programme.desc: The inovation of the engineers of Paravan in the village of Pfonstetten-Aichlau is truly outstanding, their objective: to come up with mobility solutions for people with a vast array of different disabilities.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The 4-wheel station wagon Volvo V40 Cross Country and the Mercedes Benz 4MATIC range, which includes the flagship model S500, the mid-range salon C 400 and the compact SUV GLA 250, have one thing in common. They demonstrate that you can have a lot of fun with four-wheel drive on ice, in the snow or in the clanking cold. And they prove it to you on this episode of 4x4.

programme.desc: Australian rehevät sademetsät, kosteikot ja eukalyptusmetsät ovat maapallon ainutlaatuisimpien olentojen koti. Paljastamme Australian otusten omituisimmat keinot, joiden avulla ne selviytyvät näissä äärimmäisissä elinympäristöissä, aina vesinokkaeläimen oudosta anatomiasta pussiahman villeihin huutoihin.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin lähtee Australian mantereelta etsimään saarilla asuvia eläimiä, jotka ovat sopeutuneet selviytymään ankarassa eristyksessä. Wellesleyn saarilla Phil kohtaa munivan vihreän merikilpikonnan. Myöhemmin hän jäljittää metsästävän dingolauman ja törmää kunnioitettavaan käärmeeseen, jolla on pelottava nimi - kuolemankäärme.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin lähtee Australian savannille etsimään maan pelottavimpia olentoja. Ensin hän tapaa Australian suurimman petolinnun, kiilapyrstökotkan, ja Australian aggressiivisimman käärmeen, rannikkotaipaanin. Myöhemmin hän näkee kaulusliskon ja sen kiehtovat puolustusmekanismit.

programme.title: Australian muinainen maa
programme.desc: Australian muinaisista alueista kertova ohjelma tutkii Koillis-Australian ainutlaatuisia ja ikivanhoja maisemia. Alue on mantereen monimuotoisin biodiversiteetiltään. Krokotiilit vaanivat kaloja, villisiat metsästävät ja pussieläinäidit huolehtivat pienokaisistaan kaukana pohjoisessa. Ohjelmassa nähdään kohokohtia uskomattomien lajien elämästä niiden kamppaillessa selviytymisestä vaikeissa ja vaihtuvissa oloissa.

programme.title: Kingdom of The Blue Whale
programme.desc: Maailman johtavat sinivalaiden tutkijat lähtevät National Geographic Societyn tukemina vallankumoukselliselle tehtävälle: he etsivät, tunnistavat ja merkitsevät Kalifornian sinivalaita ja hyödyntävät DNA-näytteitä valaiden sukupuolen määrittämisessä. Sen jälkeen he liittyvät näiden valtavien eläinten muuttomatkalle niiden kerääntyessä Costa Rica Domeen. Asiantuntijat havainnoivat valaiden pariutumisrituaaleja krillimassojen ja virtausten keskellä 800 kilometrin päässä Costa Rican rannikolta. He toivovat löytävänsä ja tallentavansa sinivalastutkimuksen Graalin maljan eli meren suurimman nisäkkään parittelu- ja poikimispaikan meressä.

Se on sekä raaka taistelukomentaja, joka johtaa laumansa sotaan muita kilpailijoita tai vihollisia vastaan, että laumansa omistautunut vartija ja emo jälkeläisilleen.

programme.title: Snakes in the City: No Vacancy: Compilations Season 9
programme.desc: Käärmeenpelastajat Simon, Sioux ja Mbali elävät hektistä aikaa Durbanissa. Kesän kuumuus ja liika rakentaminen tuovat kaikenlaisia käärmeitä lähikontaktiin ihmisten kanssa, ja heidän täytyy hallita paniikkia varmistaakseen sekä käärmeiden että ihmisten turvallisuuden. Tappava vihermamba havaitaan lapsia täynnä olevassa koulussa. Simon vaarantaa henkensä pelastaakseen mamban puusta. Sylkevä kobra on ansassa sisällä kaupassa, jota ympäröi aseistautunut väkijoukko. Mustamamba katoaa rakennustyömaan romuvarastoon, ja paikan työntekijät kieltäytyvät jatkamasta toimintaa tavalliseen tapaan. Mustahuulikobra saapuu häihin kuokkimaan ja pitää Simonin sekä Siouxsien arvailujen varassa.

programme.title: Espanjan rannikkovartiosto
programme.desc: Kalastusalusten rutiinitarkastuksella on arvaamattomia seurauksia. Epäilyttävä pikavene herättää päämajassa epäilykset. Tiimi lähetetään tutkimaan asiaa. Baleaareilla rannikkovartioston tiimit saavat selvittääkseen väitetyn kotiväkivaltatapauksen.

programme.title: Alaskan lentopelastajat
programme.desc: Lentokoneet ovat Alaskassa ehdottomia, sillä niillä voi toimittaa elintärkeitä tarvikkeita ja pelastaa kadonneita tai loukkaantuneita alueilla, joille tiet eivät vie. Rankat säät ja äärimmäinen maasto luovat maan vaarallisimmat ilmailuolosuhteet, joita lentäjien on kestettävä saadakseen työnsä hoidettua kaikin keinoin. Kolmiosaisessa erikoisohjelmassa tutustutaan vaaralliseen ammattiin ja hurjapäiden ottamiin riskeihin.

programme.title: Arvoitukselliset tutkimusmatkat
programme.desc: Hannah Fry vierailee Etelä-Koreassa selvittääkseen, miten kerran sodan ja jakautumisen määrittämästä maasta tuli maailmanlaajuinen voima kulttuurin, liiketoiminnan ja teknologian saralla. Hän tutkii miljardien dollareiden arvoista e-urheilun maailmaa, oppii taekwondoa mustan vyön haltijalta sekä tapaa kimchin tekemisen suurmestarin ja Jejun legendaarisia naissukeltajia. Matkan varrella hänelle selviää, miten Etelä-Korea yhdistää perinteet ja innovaatiot, oli kyse sitten perheyritysimperiumeista tai huippuluokan arkipäivän teknologiasta. Hannah paljastaa uteliaisuuden ja huumorin avulla, miten maan ainutlaatuinen yhdistelmä muinaisia arvoja ja tulevaisuuteen suuntautunutta ajattelua teki siitä kulttuurisen supervoiman, joka jatkaa elämämme muokkaamista.

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32
programme.desc: Throughout the season, the four stops offered nail-biting action in breath taking venues that brought the best out of these dynamic and fast design foiling catamarans. The level of expectation and the anticipation was extremely high and both the organizers and the participants proved that it was worth waiting for the comeback. Let’s remember the most notable moments of what was a fascinating season full of top-level sailing battles in some crystal clear blue waters.

programme.title: Le Défi Azimut
programme.desc: The Défi Azimut is an atypical event in the offshore race world. It brings together the IMOCA class and gathers the skippers of the Vendée Globe and Lorient-based company Azimut. Combining performance, innovation and strategy, it provides the best level of sailing competition with a lot of friendliness.In this edition, the Défi Azimut brings together new boats as well as experienced Imocas to compete in racing mode for five days in Lorient. Every year, this festive event gathers nautical enthusiasts together just a few weeks before the start of the Vendee Globe race. Watch the race that prioritizes the human factor as the key value and that carries out collaborative projects bringing together people around the world with a passion for the sea.

programme.title: Discovering Rhodes
programme.desc: In this second episode, we will visit the historic and picturesque Mandraki Harbour before exploring the natural attractions of Butterfly Valley and Seven Springs. Rhodes is often known as the paradise island for windsurfers, so we will not miss the chance to see how it feels to be on a board out on the open water. Finally, we will visit the must-see archaeological sites that aren’t to be missed before leaving the island, the town and the Acropolis of Lindos.

programme.title: Discovering Symi
programme.desc: Welcome to Greece and the beautiful island of Symi in the middle of the Aegean Sea. Symi is part of the Dodecanese island chain, located about forty-one kilometers northwest of Rhodes, featuring fifty-eight-point one square kilometers of mountainous terrain. In this episode we will witness the beauty of Symi’s capital, Gialos, and its neighbouring district of Chorio.

programme.title: Kite Masters
programme.desc: Welcome to Kite Masters!The series that flies you around the world, together with the very best athletes from one of the fastest, most extreme and stylish sports: kiteboarding. programme.title: Ice Canoe Carnival Quebec
programme.desc: Rowing through icy currents in the cold is not for the faint of heart. However, every year competitors jump into their canoes to race in the Ice Canoe Carnival Quebec. The Canoe Race is a legendary competition that has been held since the Carnival's first edition. When the Québec Winter Carnival returned in 1955, ice canoe racing became once again an important annual event, and is now awaited by many in the Canadian city.Each year, several courageous teams compete in extremely freezing conditions a tumultuous ride along the St. Lawrence River between Quebec City and Levis. Find out which team will win against the cold and icy Canadian conditions!

programme.title: Wind Masters
programme.desc: Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.​In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.​If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.​

programme.desc: Durban: a coastal city in eastern South Africa’s KwaZulu-Natal province known for its diverse influences and for hosting the Durban Extravaganza. programme.title: Dangerous Waters
programme.desc: The Dangerous Waters crewmembers will ride an epic adventure like no other on their JetSki. Their world-first adventure is plagued with wildlife, wicked waters, tropical storms and new unknown challenges they will have to overcome. As the conditions worsen, crewmembers are forced to drastically take decisions in an environment where not all will get to their final destination.Become part of the crew as they battle the elements on their JetSkis, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM F1H2O World Championship is the flagship series of international single-seater inshore circuit Formula powerboat racing. It attracts up to 20 of the world’s leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h on the straights.Watch them race through the water in an epic H20 Racing: F1H20 World Championship that has nothing to envy from land F1, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Jet Ski World Series
programme.desc: Put your helmets on because we are getting started with the Jet Ski World Series! Delivering whooping speeds of 100km/hr in under 3.8 seconds and with 500 horsepower, riders need to be sharp to turn 30 degrees at 140 km/h, putting the 'Jet' in Jet Ski. Wearing no protective body, grappling with the waves and fighting out with gravity, the riders that dare challenge this competition are some of the most corageous athletes in the world. Are you going to miss out? Tune up to the latest edition of the Jet Ski World Series!

programme.title: Durban Extravaganza
programme.desc: Durban: a coastal city in eastern South Africa’s KwaZulu-Natal province known for its diverse influences and for hosting the Durban Extravaganza. The City of Durban and Durban Stars have brought the heat to the beautiful beachfront with the Surfing South Africa sanctioned Pro Surf Tour competition. Over 3 three days, the top 100 surfers gather in the South African city to participate in the hottest surfing competition of the African country.You can expect high-level competition with waves that are over 2-3 foot in Durban Extravaganza. Competing at the Bay of Plenty, surfers will surely dive in for plenty of action. A fanta-SEA for surf lovers!

programme.desc: Frozen Waterfalls - Icekayaking

programme.title: Ice Canoe Carnival Quebec
programme.desc: Rowing through icy currents in the cold is not for the faint of heart. However, every year competitors jump into their canoes to race in the Ice Canoe Carnival Quebec. The Canoe Race is a legendary competition that has been held since the Carnival's first edition. When the Québec Winter Carnival returned in 1955, ice canoe racing became once again an important annual event, and is now awaited by many in the Canadian city.Each year, several courageous teams compete in extremely freezing conditions a tumultuous ride along the St. Lawrence River between Quebec City and Levis. Find out which team will win against the cold and icy Canadian conditions!

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: The island of Rab has a rich history and has been inhabited by numerous great personalities. The Romans named this place Felix Arba or Lucky, which actually means Happy island. With 30 sandy beaches, Rab is truly a happy island and its beauty has been recognized by tourists from around the world for almost 125 years.

programme.title: Sail-Ho

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32
programme.desc: Throughout the season, the four stops offered nail-biting action in breath taking venues that brought the best out of these dynamic and fast design foiling catamarans. programme.title: Le Défi Azimut
programme.desc: The Défi Azimut is an atypical event in the offshore race world. It brings together the IMOCA class and gathers the skippers of the Vendée Globe and Lorient-based company Azimut. Combining performance, innovation and strategy, it provides the best level of sailing competition with a lot of friendliness.In this edition, the Défi Azimut brings together new boats as well as experienced Imocas to compete in racing mode for five days in Lorient. Every year, this festive event gathers nautical enthusiasts together just a few weeks before the start of the Vendee Globe race. Watch the race that prioritizes the human factor as the key value and that carries out collaborative projects bringing together people around the world with a passion for the sea.

programme.title: Capri
programme.desc: Umberto ha tradito Vittoria con Ines e, resosi conto dell'errore, cerca in ogni modo di non farlo sapere a quella che crede essere la donna della sua vita. Ma un paparazzo ha scattato delle foto e, in tutta l'isola, non si fa altro che parlare dell'amante caprese della bella violinista. Nonostante il re di Capri cerchi di comprare tutte le copie del giornale su cui è uscita la foto, all'occhio di Reginella non è sfuggito un dettaglio che rivela l'identità dell'uomo che bacia la musicista.

programme.title: Capri
programme.desc: Il fragile castello di bugie costruito da Umberto per nascondere a Vittoria il suo tradimento finisce col crollare: l'intera isola ha capito che il misterioso amante della violinista è lui e la donna si sente ferita e presa in giro. Intanto, Reginella scopre che il professor Helmut è gravemente malato e per questo si decide a chiamare la sua ex-moglie. Massimo decide che è arrivato il momento di raccontare al piccolo Nicola come sia scomparsa sua madre.

programme.title: Il restauratore
programme.desc: Restaurando una vecchia bilancia che appartiene a Maccari, Basilio vede la figlia del vice questore e una sua amica coinvolte in un incidente mortale. Basilio riesce a salvare solo una delle due ragazze mentre l'altra finisce in coma, vittima di un pirata della strada. Maccari è accecato dalla rabbia e intende inchiodare il colpevole, costi quel che costi. Non sarà facile per Basilio capire cosa fare per impedire che il suo migliore amico non si rovini la vita per portare a termine una vendetta.

programme.title: Il restauratore
programme.desc: Il contatto con una marionetta trovata in un baule genera una nuova luccicanza per Basilio: l'omicidio di una donna che cade in una piscina e un uomo colpito a morte dalla freccia di una balestra. Sembra un delitto passionale che non lascia adito a ulteriori indagini, un uomo che sorprende la moglie con il suo migliore amico. Ma dietro quell'apparente verità si nasconde un piano diabolico.
